title: Axebot

moves.title: Boot Up
effects: Apply Strength to self (amount scales with stock usage)

move_pattern: Starts with Hammer Uppercut. Then alternates between The One-Two and Hammer Uppercut.
notes: Axebot has a stock mechanic (defaults to 2). When stock is consumed or depleted, it may enter a different combat phase starting with Boot Up. The Strength gain from Boot Up scales inversely with remaining stock: Base 4 Strength × (2 - current stock). At max stock (2), gains 0 Strength. This encourages players to deplete the stock.
